spans.s:
NIGH (adj. and adv.): v. Near (adj. and
adv.).
NIGHTCAP: नैशं शिरस्कम्, and sim. expr.s.

NIGHT-DRESS: नैशी वेशः(षः), Ri. v. 14. and sim.
expr.s.

NIGHTLY (adv.):
I By night:
(1) by loc.:
रात्रौ, etc.;
(2) निशि;
(3) नक्तम्।
II Every
night:
(1) प्रतिरात्रम्:
(2) निशि निशि; etc.

NIGHTMARE:
he had a n.:
भूतस्तं पीडयामास स्वप्ने
(after Bengali).

NIGHT-WATCH:
I Lit.: यामः: v. Watch.
II A guard: q. v.: नगररक्षिन् (m.), Ma.
viii.
